facial_motor_units_fused.name: Brow Lowerer
facial_motor_units_fused.action_description: A posed illustration of the displayed movement; it does not determine emotion.
facial_motor_units_fused.image_prompt: Photorealistic clinical still of an adult face, square crop, 85mm equivalent, f/8, camera on the Frankfort plane. Isolate the glabella and medial brows. Show FACS AU4 at high intensity: corrugator supercilii and procerus contracted, two sharp vertical furrows between the eyebrows, brows drawn together and down so they press toward the upper lids, no medial brow raise (no AU1), no lateral brow arch (no AU2). Even dermatology lighting from two large softboxes at 45 degrees, no beauty-glam catchlights, visible pores and vellus hair, natural mixed skin, no makeup, no retouching of wrinkles. Neutral shoulders cropped out. Exclude smile, tears, and horror-wide lids. --ar 1:1
